title: The Girl Who Trod on Bread (The Sparrow's Flight)
summary: Frozen into a stone statue in the underworld for stepping upon a loaf of bread, Inger's soul was pierced by the tear of a child who prayed for her forgiveness....
keywords: the girl who trod on bread variant
full_text:
Frozen into a stone statue in the underworld for stepping upon a loaf of bread, Inger's soul was pierced by the tear of a child who prayed for her forgiveness.

Transformed into a humble little gray bird, she flew through freezing winters gathering breadcrumbs to feed starving birds, until she had gathered crumbs equal to the whole loaf she had despised.

With a joyful chirp, her wings turned white as snow, and she ascended into the eternal sunlight of divine grace.
moral: Selfish vanity sinks into the mire, but self-forgetting labor for others lifts the soul to light.
